cards.ex: He's really laid-back about his exams; nothing seems to stress him out.
cards.exUz: U imtihonlar haqida juda xotirjam; hech narsa uni tashvishga solmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatga beparvo, tinch va xotirjam bo'lish.

cards.ex: His constant complaining really gets on my nerves.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy shikoyatlari asabimga tegadi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir asabini buzish, jahliga tegish.

cards.ex: She's a real people person and makes friends easily.
cards.exUz: U juda kirishimli va oson do'st orttiradi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar bilan oson til topisha oladigan odam.

cards.ex: We need to think outside the box to solve this problem.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni hal qilish uchun biz standartdan tashqari fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi, ijodiy va odatiy bo'lmagan yechimlarni o'ylash.

cards.ex: The new employee is eager to please and always volunteers for tasks.
cards.exUz: Yangi xodim yoqishga tayyor va har doim vazifalarni bajarishga o'z ixtiyori bilan yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarni xursand qilishga juda harakat qiladigan.

cards.ex: Don't jump to conclusions; let's hear all the facts first.
cards.exUz: Xulosa chiqarishga shoshilmang; avval barcha faktlarni eshitaylik.
cards.uzDef: Dalillarni to'liq ko'rib chiqmasdan xulosa chiqarish.

cards.ex: He always goes the extra mile to help his colleagues.
cards.exUz: U har doim hamkasblariga yordam berish uchun ko'proq harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan ko'proq harakat qilish, qo'shimcha mehnat qilish.

cards.ex: My grandfather is very set in his ways and doesn't like trying new things.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom o'z yo'lida qattiq turadi va yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rishni yoqtirmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Odatlariga qattiq yopishgan, o'zgarishni istamaydigan.

cards.ex: She takes everything in stride and never gets too stressed.
cards.exUz: U hamma narsani xotirjam qabul qiladi va hech qachon juda stressga tushmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarni xotirjamlik bilan qabul qilish va hal qilish.

cards.ex: He's a bit of a pushover and lets people take advantage of him.
cards.exUz: U biroz bo'sh odam va odamlarga undan foydalanishga ruxsat beradi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlikcha ta'sirga beriladigan, yo'q deyish qiyin bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: She tends to hold a grudge, so be careful what you say.
cards.exUz: U xafagarchilik saqlashga moyil, shuning uchun nima deyishingizga ehtiyot bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga nisbatan uzoq vaqt davomida xafagarchilikni saqlash.

cards.ex: He always speaks his mind, even if it's not what people want to hear.
cards.exUz: U har doim fikrini ayon qiladi, hatto odamlar eshitishni xohlamasa ham.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini ochiq va to'g'ri ifoda etish, nima o'ylayotganini aytish.

cards.ex: He tried to butter me up before asking for a favor.
cards.exUz: U mendan iltimos qilishdan oldin meni maqtab erkalatmoqchi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir roziligini olish uchun ularni maqtab erkalatish.

cards.ex: You need to get your act together and stop being so irresponsible.
cards.exUz: O'zingni qo'lga olishing va bunchalik mas'uliyatsiz bo'lishni to'xtatishing kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zingni tartibga solish, yaxshiroq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She has a heart of gold and is always helping others.
cards.exUz: Uning oltin yuragi bor va har doim boshqalarga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Juda mehribon va saxovatli odam.

cards.ex: He's a bit of a control freak and likes everything done his way.
cards.exUz: U biroz nazorat o'chog'i va hamma narsa o'z uslubida qilinishini yoqtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani nazorat qilishni istaydigan odam.

cards.ex: We're always on the same wavelength, so it's easy to work together.
cards.exUz: Biz har doim bir to'lqinda bo'lamiz, shuning uchun birga ishlash oson.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash fikrlarga ega bo'lish, bir xil tarzda fikrlash.

cards.ex: He tends to fly off the handle when things go wrong.
cards.exUz: Vaziyat yomonlashganda u g'azablanishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Birdan g'azablanish, o'zini yo'qotish.

cards.ex: I'm just playing devil's advocate to see if your idea holds up.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki qarshi fikr bildirmoqdaman, g'oyangiz qanchalik asosli ekanligini ko'rish uchun.
cards.uzDef: Bahsda boshqa nuqtai nazarni qo'llab-quvvatlash, bahsga sabab bo'lish.

cards.ex: She wears her heart on her sleeve, so everyone knows how she's feeling.
cards.exUz: U o'z his-tuyg'ularini yashirmaydi, shuning uchun hamma uning qanday his qilayotganini biladi.
cards.term: wear your heart on your sleeve
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini ochiq ko'rsatish, yashirmaslik.

cards.ex: I'm always here if you need a shoulder to cry on.
cards.exUz: Agar sizga dardkash do'st kerak bo'lsa, men har doim shu yerdaman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda yordam beradigan, hamdard bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: Even when others disagreed, she stuck to her guns and defended her position.
cards.exUz: Boshqalar rozi bo'lmasa ham, u o'z fikrida qat'iy turdi va o'z pozitsiyasini himoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikriga sodiq qolish, qat'iy turish.

cards.ex: It's better to take the high road and not stoop to their level.
cards.exUz: Ularning darajasiga tushmaslik va olijanob yo'lni tanlash yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Murakkab vaziyatda to'g'ri va axloqiy yo'lni tanlash.

cards.ex: He has a short fuse, so be careful what you say around him.
cards.exUz: U tez g'azablanadi, shuning uchun uning atrofida nima deyishingizga ehtiyot bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Osonlikcha g'azablanadigan, sabrsiz.

cards.ex: He turned out to be a fair-weather friend; he disappeared when I needed him most.
cards.exUz: U vaqtinchalik do'st bo'lib chiqdi; men eng muhtoj bo'lganimda g'oyib bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat yaxshi paytlarda do'st bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: He didn't lift a finger to help with the cleaning.
cards.exUz: U tozalashga yordam berish uchun hech narsa qilmadi.
cards.uzDef: Yordam berish uchun hech qanday harakat qilmaslik.

cards.ex: You can't just bury your head in the sand; you need to face the problem.
cards.exUz: Shunchaki muammolarni e'tiborsiz qoldirmang; muammoga duch kelishingiz kerak.
cards.term: bury your head in the sand
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni e'tiborsiz qoldirish, ularni inkor etish.

cards.ex: I think he's bitten off more than he can chew with all those projects.
cards.exUz: O'ylaymanki, u barcha loyihalar bilan qo'lidan kelmaydigan ishni oldi.
cards.term: bite off more than you can chew
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari ko'p vazifani o'z zimmasiga olish.

cards.ex: He's a bad egg; I wouldn't trust him with anything.
cards.exUz: U yomon odam; men unga hech narsa ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchsiz, yomon xulqli odam.

cards.ex: We must have got our wires crossed; I thought you were bringing the drinks.
cards.exUz: Bizda tushunmovchilik bo'lgan bo'lishi kerak; men siz ichimliklarni olib keladi deb o'yladim.
cards.uzDef: Tushunmovchilik yuzaga kelish, noto'g'ri aloqa.
